title: Flow-Matching-Based Controllable Image and Video Editing
summary: I am developing a controllable image and video editing framework based on Flow Matching.
detail: The project aims to support fast, locally controllable, and traceable chain-of-edit operations, making each editing step easier to understand, follow, and refine.
invitation: I welcome researchers working on generative models, visual editing, and related areas to discuss ideas and explore potential collaborations.
